summary: Sony and Media.Vision's western-fantasy JRPG series, spanning the original PlayStation games, PS2 sequels and remake, PSP tactical spinoff, Japanese mobile services, and modern PlayStation Classics routes.

entries.title: Wild Arms
entries.definitive_edition: PlayStation Classics release for the original game

emulation.emulator: Official PlayStation Classics emulator; DuckStation as preservation alternative
emulation.notes: Use the official PS4/PS5 release for a public modern route, or DuckStation with a legally dumped disc for configurable capture.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Official up-rendered PlayStation output or emulator-upscaled PlayStation output.

primary.why: The modern PlayStation Classics release is an official version of the original PlayStation game with up-rendering, rewind, quick save, filters, and trophy support, making it the best fidelity-and-convenience route for the original game.
primary.how_to_play: Play the PS4/PS5 PlayStation Classics version; use the rewind and quick-save features only as convenience tools if preserving original balance matters.

secondary.exclusive_content: Alter Code: F is a separate enhanced remake with expanded script, new 3D presentation, extra playable characters, redesigned dungeons, and additional scenarios.
secondary.what_to_play: Play Wild Arms Alter Code: F separately if covering remake-only story and design changes.
secondary.why: The remake has enough distinct content and presentation changes to be treated as its own entry rather than a replacement for the original.

entries.remaster_caveats: The PS4/PS5 release is an emulated Classics conversion, not a full remake; Alter Code: F should be treated separately.

entries.title: Wild Arms 3

emulation.emulator: Official PS4 PS2 emulator; PCSX2 as preservation alternative
emulation.notes: Use the official PS4 route for public availability or PCSX2 for configurable capture from a legal dump.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Official up-rendered PS2 output or PCSX2 upscaled output.

primary.why: Wild Arms 3 has an official PS4 release converted from the PS2 version with up-rendering and trophies, making it the cleanest official high-fidelity route.
primary.how_to_play: Play the PS4 version from PlayStation Store; it is also playable on PS5 through backwards compatibility, though it remains classified as a PS4 title.

entries.remaster_caveats: The PS4 release is an emulated conversion and may differ from the original PS2 version in some edge cases.

entries.title: Wild Arms Alter Code: F

emulation.notes: Use high internal resolution and widescreen only if it does not break presentation.

primary.why: Alter Code: F is a PS2 enhanced remake of the first Wild Arms with new 3D presentation, expanded script, more playable characters, redesigned dungeons, and additional scenarios; no official modern release is documented.
primary.how_to_play: Use a legally dumped PS2 disc in PCSX2 with high internal resolution; play separately from the original Wild Arms because its remake changes are substantial.

entries.remaster_caveats: No official modern remaster exists; the North American version removed Japanese voices from some movie scenes.

entries.title: Wild Arms 5

emulation.notes: Use high internal resolution; verify any Wild Arms XF connectivity requirements before starting a completionist run.

primary.why: Wild Arms 5 remains a PS2 title in the West, with a Japanese PSN route documented later; for an English playthrough, PCSX2 with a legal PS2 disc is the highest-fidelity practical route.
primary.how_to_play: Use the North American or PAL PS2 release in PCSX2 with high internal resolution. For completionist coverage, preserve a Wild Arms XF save path if attempting documented cross-game unlocks.

entries.remaster_caveats: No official English modern remaster documented.

emulation.notes: Use internal-resolution scaling and verify any save-link requirements before completionist coverage.

primary.why: Wild Arms XF is documented as the series' PSP tactical RPG spinoff; PPSSPP provides the cleanest high-resolution capture route for the PSP release.
primary.how_to_play: Use a legally dumped PSP copy in PPSSPP with increased internal resolution; if chasing cross-game content, also verify the Wild Arms 5 connection setup.

emulation.notes: Service and handset preservation are the limiting factors.

primary.version: Yahoo! Keitai / I-Mode / EZWeb mobile service
primary.why: Wild Arms Mobile is documented as a Japanese feature-phone service with Wild Arms-themed minigames and downloadable franchise content.
primary.how_to_play: Treat as a historical mobile-service entry unless original supported hardware and service files are legally available; do not plan it as a normal modern playthrough.

entries.title: Wild Arms: Million Memories

emulation.notes: Live-service shutdown is the limiting factor.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Original mobile-client output while the service existed.

primary.why: Million Memories was released for Japanese smartphones in 2018 and was shut down in 2020, so its original mobile service is the defining version.
primary.how_to_play: Treat as a historical service game unless a legal preserved client route exists; do not plan a normal live-service playthrough.

entries.remaster_caveats: Service ended February 27, 2020; no modern offline rerelease documented.
